title: P11 · start the mission clock
code: DCA	REP11S		# DIRECT RESTARTS TO REP11
operation: Preserve liftoff time, zero the onboard elapsed-time counters and protect the sequence against restart.
effect: The spacecraft gets a common time reference for navigation and scheduled work. This does not ignite the F-1 engines.

title: P11 · monitor the climb
code: CADR	PREREAD1	# ZERO PIPS AND INITIALIZE AVERAGEG
CA      POWDNCOD        # SWITCH TO POWERED FLIGHT DOWNLIST
CADR	CLEANDSP	# CLEAR DSKY IN CASE OF V75
operation: Initialize the acceleration-reading service, schedule attitude-error display and change the major mode to 11.
effect: The crew can compare spacecraft navigation against the launch vehicle. Saturn’s LVDC controls nominal steering.

title: SERVICER · integrate acceleration
code: +5		# DO NOT COUNT 'TTE' IF DRAG > 0.05 G.
STORE	TTE		# NEGATIVE AS IN A COUNTDOWN.
# DURING P61 THRU P63, 'TTE' IS DECREMENTED
# AND IS ON CALL AND ON ENTRY DNLIST.
VLOAD	ABVAL		# GET ABS VALUE OF DELV
TC	GENTRAN		# INTO RN, VN, GDT/12, GOBL/2,PIPTIME
operation: Accumulate velocity change and run the average-gravity/state update.
effect: Navigation estimates the changing velocity and position; this is sensing and computation, not a direct thruster command.

title: ORBITAL INTEGRATION · predict the coast
code: PDDL	NORM		# NORM R (+29 OR +27 - N1)	2D	PL 4D
input: Position, velocity, elapsed time and gravity model
operation: The integration package propagates a state vector between observations.
effect: Coasting motion is gravity-driven. This source documents a navigation capability, not an engine command.

title: P47 · measure velocity change
code: P47CSM		TC	BANKCALL	# IMU STATUS CHECK
CA	MPAC +1		# DELTA TIME TO RPEREAD (LESS THAN 1000
TS	P40TMP		#	CS, WITH A TPAGREE, INT.INIT.)
2CADR	TIGON		# TIGON IS REQUIRED TO MATHCHTAT AND AVEG
CAF	PRIO30		# FORCE ZEROING OF N83 BEFORE SERVICER
input: Accelerometer readings from the spacecraft IMU
operation: Check IMU status and initialize the delta-V monitoring sequence.
effect: A spacecraft monitoring capability relevant to external thrust. It does not establish that this exact source range was executing at the selected mission instant.

title: P30 · prepare the maneuver
code: ADRES	XDELVFLG	# SET XDELVFLG BIT 8 FLAG 2
ADRES	UPDATFLG	# RESET UPDATFLG BIT 7 FLAG 1
ADRES	NORMSW		# RESET NORMSW BIT 10 FLAG 7
input: Crew/ground target: ignition time and desired delta-V
operation: Select external delta-V targeting, accept the maneuver data and prepare calculations.
effect: A requested change in velocity is translated into the inputs that a burn program needs.

title: P40CSM · configure an SPS burn
code: ECSTEER		# IS THIS AN EXTERNAL DELTA V BURN
FENG		# SET UP THRUST FOR P40 20,000 LBS
P40S/F		STODL	F		# P41 ENTERS HERE
TIG		# ORIGINAL TIG MAY BE SLIPPED BY P40S/SV
STORE	NOMTIG		# SET ORIGINAL TIME OF IGNITION FOR S40.9
P40SXTY		TCR	SETMINDB -1	# NARROW DEADBAND FOR MANEUVER (EBANK6)
input: Ignition target, spacecraft mass and steering mode
operation: Set the steering law and thrust model, preserve ignition time, and prepare the spacecraft maneuver.
effect: The Service Propulsion System can execute the prepared maneuver with the spacecraft’s digital autopilot.

title: S40.8 · steer toward the target
code: VLOAD	BVSU		# CONSTRUCT DELVG, SC.AT B+7 M/CS
STORE	VG		# VELOCITY-TO-BE-GAINED, SC.AT B+7 M/CS
OCT	10035		# TYPE B RESTART BELOW AND 5.3 REREADAC
operation: Update the powered-flight steering solution.
effect: The guidance loop reduces the velocity error while the engine changes the trajectory. This animation illustrates the causal role.

title: R60CSM · request an attitude maneuver
code: # REV 13	CONFORMS TO GSOP CHAPTER FOUR REVISION LOGIC 09	JAN 18, 1968
# INSERT PRIODSP CHECK WITH R22 (V06N49) WITH JENNINGS BRODEUR
STORE	CPHI		# STORE FINAL ANGLES - CPHI, CTHETA, CPSI
CADR	GOPERF2R	# DISPLAY PLEASE PERFORM AUTO MANEUVER
input: Requested vehicle attitude and IMU orientation
operation: Prepare and dispatch the attitude maneuver routine.
effect: Orient the spacecraft for docking, observation or thrust. A DAP translates attitude errors into actuator requests.

title: RCSATT · attitude feedback
code: CAF	BIT15		# BIT15 CHAN31 = 0 IF IMU POWER IS ON AND
EXTEND			# S/C CONT SW IS IN CMC (I.E. IF G/C AUTO
RAND	CHAN31		# PILOT IS FULLY ENABLED)
BZF	SETT5		# IF G/C AUTOPILOT IS FULLY ENABLED,
CS	RCSFLAGS	# IF G/C AUTOPILOT IS NOT FULLY ENABLED,
CAF	ZERO		# ZERO ERRORX, ERRORY, AND ERRORZ,
RAND	CHAN31		# AND CHECK FREE FUNCTION (BIT14 CHAN31).
input: Gimbal angles, target attitude and rate errors
operation: Run the reaction-control digital autopilot through its interrupt-driven cycle.
effect: Small thruster impulses turn the CSM. Translational docking commands also involve the crew’s hand controller.

title: Physical failure · no AGC trigger
operation: Tank rupture and oxygen loss damage the power/life-support system.
effect: There is no authentic AGC source line to show for causing this accident. Crew and ground teams develop the abort response.

title: DOFSTART · initialize Aquarius
code: DOFSTART	CAF	BIT14		# INSURE ENGINE IS OFF.
TS	RCSFLAGS	# INITIALIZE ATTITUDE ERROR DISPLAYS.
TS	RESTREG		# SUPER BANK PRIORITY FOR DISPLAYS.
TS	PVALVEST	# FOR RCS FAILURE MONITOR
TS	ERESTORE	# ***** MUST NOT BE REMOVED FROM DOFSTART
TS	SMODE		# ***** MUST NOT BE REMOVED FROM DOFSTART
TS	UPSVFLAG	# ZERO UPDATE STATE VECTOR REQUEST FLAGWRD
WRITE	CHAN5		# TURN OFF RCS JETS.
operation: Begin a protected fresh start and put engine-control outputs in a safe state.
effect: The LGC becomes available as a navigation and control computer. The crew must still power and configure the LM systems.

title: Fresh start / restart · restore Odyssey
code: #	3.	CLEAR FAIL REGISTERS,SELF CHECK ERROR COUNTER AND RESTART
#	1.	CLEAR SELF-CHECK REGISTERS, MODE REGISTER AND CDUZ REGISTER
#	5.	TRANSFER CONTROL TO IDLE LOOP IN DUMMYJOB
#	1.	TRANSFER CONTROL TO DOFSTART IF ANY OF THE FOLLOWING CONDITIONS
#		A.	RESTART OCCURED DURING EXECUTION OF ERASCHK
#		B.	BOTH OSCILLATOR FAIL AND AGC WARNING ARE ON
#		C.	MARK REJECT AND EITHER NAV OR MAIN DSKY ERROR LIGHT RESET
operation: The source describes initialization of flags, mode state and the executive idle loop.
effect: A computer restart is one part of the crew’s larger command-module power-up procedure. These comments describe capability, not a recorded boot trace.

title: P52 · align the inertial reference
code: TC	BANKCALL	# FLASH OPTION CODE AND ORIENTATION CODE
TC	P52B		# NEW CODE - NEW ORIENTATION CODE INPUT
DCA	TLAND		# IF OPTION 4 DISPLAY TLAND
operation: Select the reference orientation used by the alignment routine.
effect: Guidance needs a trusted orientation before a burn. Actual Apollo 13 alignment procedures combined crew observations and ground instructions.

title: P30 · enter the rescue target
code: P30		TC	UPFLAG		# SET UPDATE FLAG
P30N33		CAF	V06N33		# T OF IGN
TC	VNPOOH		# RETURNS ON PROCEED, POOH ON TERMINATE
PARAM30		CAF	V06N42		# DISPLAY APOGEE,PERIGEE,DELTA V
input: Time of ignition and local-vertical delta-V components
operation: Display the ignition time and delta-V, then set external delta-V targeting.
effect: The ground-computed rescue maneuver becomes a target for Aquarius’s burn program.

title: P40LM · prepare the descent engine
code: TC	BANKCALL	# GO DO IMU STATUS CHECK ROUTINE.
TC	INTPRET		# LOAD CONSTANTS FOR DPS BURN
VLOAD	CLEAR		# LOAD F, MDOT, TDECAY
STCALL	VEX		# LOAD EXHAUST VELOCITY FOR TGO COMP.
CADR	PFLITEDB	# ZERO ATTITUDE ERRORS, SET DB TO ONE DEG.
input: DPS maneuver target, docked configuration and IMU state
operation: Choose the P40 ignition table, check the IMU, load DPS constants and prepare the thrust attitude.
effect: Aquarius uses the descent engine while docked to Odyssey. This is a propulsion maneuver, not a lunar descent.

title: IGNITION · issue engine-on
code: IGNYET?		CAF	ASTNBIT		# CHECK ASTNFLAG:  HAS ASTRONAUT RESPONDED
MASK	FLAGWRD7	# TO OUR ENGINE ENABLE REQUEST?
BZF	12		# BRANCH IF HE HAS NOT RESPONDED YET
IGNITION	CS	FLAGWRD5	# INSURE ENGONFLG IS SET.
CS	PRIO30		# TURN ON THE ENGINE.
operation: Check the crew-response flag and write the engine-on request to the discrete-output channel.
effect: This is the real software/hardware boundary: a channel write requests engine ignition when the hardware and crew configuration permit it.

title: S40.8 · close the velocity gap
code: S40.8		BOF			# GENERATE VR IF NOT EXTERNAL DELTA-V BURN
VGAIN*		STORE	VG		# VELOCITY TO BE GAINED SCALED AT (7) M/CS
ALARMIT		# DELV IS MORE THAN 90 DEGREES FROM VG.
operation: Subtract delivered velocity, transform the result, and compute remaining burn time.
effect: The direction and remaining duration of thrust follow the evolving velocity error. The shown vectors are educational representations.

title: ENGINOF3 · stop thrust
code: ENGINOF3	CS	ENGONBIT	# INSURE ENGONFLG IS CLEAR.
CS	PRIO30		# ENGINOF3 IS USED AS A PRE-ENGINE ARM
AD	PRIO20		# TURN OFF THE ENGINE - DPS OR APS
CS	DAPBOOLS	# TURN OFF TRIM GIMBAL
CS	HIRTHROT	# ZERO AUTO-THROTTLE WHENEVER THE ENGINE
CAF	BIT4		# THE HARDWARE DOES SO ONLY WHEN THE
operation: Clear the engine-on flag, issue the engine-off channel word and zero automatic throttle.
effect: A software output removes thrust demand. Real valves, engine dynamics and crew switches are outside the CPU.

title: SERVICER · Aquarius navigation
code: SERVICER	TC	PHASCHNG	# RESTART REREADAC + SERVICER
CAF	PRIO31		# INITIALIZE 1/PIPADT IN CASE RESTART HAS
TS	1/PIPADT	# CAUSED LASTBIAS TO BE SKIPPED.
DXCH	MASS1		# INITIALIZE MASS1 IN CASE WE SKIP MASSMON
MASSMON		CS	FLAGWRD8	# ARE WE ON THE SURFACE?
operation: Schedule protected state-vector processing and navigation updates.
effect: A source-level navigation capability. During low-power coast, operating modes and powered equipment depend on crew procedures.

title: Manual control · the crew closes the loop
input: Earth-in-window reference, crew timing and hand controls
operation: The crew holds attitude and starts/stops the correction according to the procedure.
effect: No source range is presented as an autonomous controller for this action. Linked computer routines elsewhere are capabilities, not proof they steered this manual burn.

title: P47 · delta-V monitor capability
code: TCF	REDO4.2		# CHECKS PHASE 5 AND GOES TO PREREAD
operation: Initialize a velocity-change monitoring program.
effect: This is an available software capability, not a claim that P47 ran during the historical 105-hour manually timed correction.

title: Q/R RCS autopilot · small attitude impulses
code: CALLQERR	CA	BIT13		# CALCULATE Q,R ERRORS UNLESS THESE AXES
EXTEND			# ARE IN MANUAL RATE COMMAND.
TCF	+5		# IN AUTO COMPUTE Q,R ERRORS
CS	DAPBOOLS	# IN MANUAL RATE COMMAND?
BZF	Q,RORGTS	# IF SO BYPASS CALCULATION OF ERRORS.
Q,RORGTS	CCS	COTROLER	# CHOOSE CONTROL SYSTEM FOR THIS DAP PASS:
TCF	GOTOGTS		#	GTS (ALTERNATES WITH RCS WHEN DOCKED)
TCF	TRYGTS		#	GTS IF ALLOWED, OTHERWISE RCS
RCS		CAF	ZERO		#	RCS (TRYGTS MAY BRANCH TO HERE)
operation: The Q/R-axis autopilot computes and schedules reaction-control activity.
effect: LM reaction-control jets provide small impulses. The final trim was a crew-directed maneuver; the map is not an instruction trace.

title: Separation hardware · no modeled AGC command
operation: Release the appropriate module using its dedicated hardware.
effect: The animation shows which hardware remains attached. The displayed source does not command module jettison.

title: P61 / P62 · prepare entry
code: TC	NEWMODEX		# MODE CHANGE IF CAME FROM P61.
MM	62			# MODE CHANGE AUTOMATIC VIA V 37.
P62		TC	S61.1			# CHECK STATE VECTOR AND IMU ORIENTATION.
CM/DAPIC		# START CM/POSE AND BODY RATE CALC
# AND RETURNS IN BASIC TO P62.2.
DCA	POSECADR		# CONTINUE WITH CM/POSE AFTER AV G.
input: Entry state vector, landing target and IMU alignment
operation: Change entry mode, check the navigation/IMU state and calculate desired entry attitude.
effect: Odyssey is oriented for entry. The heat shield, not the LM, is the primary thermal protection.

title: P64 · atmospheric guidance
code: # MOD NO: 2	MOD BY: RR BAIRNSFATHER		DATE: 8 MAY 68		REVISED COMMENTS FOR COLOSSUS
# MOD NO: 3	MOD BY: RR BAIRNSFATHER		DATE: 1 MAR '69  N74
# FUNCTION-	1.  TO START ENTRY GUIDANCE AT .05G SELECTING ROLL ATTITUDE, CONSTANT DRAG LEVEL, AND
#		    DRAG THRESHOLD, KA, WHICH ARE KEYED TO THE .05G POINT.
#		2.  SELECT FINAL PHASE P67 IF V < 27000 FPS WHEN .2G OCCURS.
#		3.  ITERATE FOR UP-CONTROL SOLUTION P65 IF V > 27000 FPS AND IF ALTITUDE RATE AND DRAG
#		    LEVEL CONDITIONS ARE SATISFIED.  ENTER P65 WHEN CONSTANT DRAG CONTROLLER HAS BROUGHT RANGE
#		    AS PREDICTED TO WITHIN 25 NM OF DESIRED RANGE.
#		4.  SELECT FINAL PHASE  P67  IF NO UP-CONTROL SOLUTION EXISTS WITH VL > 18000 FPS.
# CALLING SEQUENCE-  BY RTB FROM REENTRY CONTROL
# THIS DISPLAY IS CALLED EACH PASS THROUGH STEERING.  RESTART PROTECTION IS VIA STEERING.
P64		TC	NEWMODEX		# ENTER VIA RTB WHEN .05G IS EXCEEDED.
# XXX.XX DEG	XXXXX. FPS	XXX.XX G
TC	DANZIG			# ... AND CONTINUE IN INITROLL ...
# MOD NO:  0	MOD BY:  RR BAIRNSFATHER	DATE:  17 JAN 68	COLOSSUS GSOP ADDITION.
# FUNCTION:	TO CONTINUE ENTRY GUIDANCE, USING THE UP-CONTROL PHASE TO STEER TO A CONTROLLED EXIT
#		CONDITION.  THIS PHASE TERMINATES  A) IF D < Q7 FPSS, GO TO P66   ,
input: Atmospheric deceleration and current navigation state
operation: Enter P64 when the 0.05 g condition is exceeded and initialize the next guidance phase.
effect: The complete entry algorithm determines bank guidance through several phases; this snippet shows a phase transition, not the entire trajectory solution.

title: CM entry DAP · drive the jets
code: MP	SINTRIM		# LET SIN(-20) BE APPROX FOR TAN(-20)
TC	2D/SDZ		# GO TEST DZ.  GET TAG: +0 IF IN DZ
# START PITCH AUTOPILOT HERE.  RATE DAMPING ONLY.
EXDAPIN		INDEX	A		# COME HERE FROM EX ATM DAP
ADS	JETEM		# COMBINE ALL NEW BITS.
EXTEND			# DOES NOT REQUIRE SAVING OLD CODES.
WRITE	PYJETS		# SET PYCHAN TO DESIRED BIT CONFIG.
input: Entry attitude/rate errors and selected jets
operation: Update the pitch/yaw jet output word.
effect: RCS changes the capsule’s attitude. Aerodynamic lift and drag then shape the entry path; this is distinct from a propulsion burn.

title: Earth landing system · recovery
input: Altitude/sequence conditions and crew backup controls
operation: Deploy drogues and main parachutes through the landing system.
effect: No invented AGC parachute routine. The three main canopies and ocean descent are an illustrative hardware sequence.
